meta.title: Original open-source project defects (real-world, version-anchored)
meta.purpose: Address reviewer criticism that prior validation used single-file reconstructed PoCs; collect defects from real project git history with fixing commits and buildable environments.

defect_family_legend.memory-safety: heap/stack overflow, out-of-bounds read/write, use-after-free, double free
defect_family_legend.concurrency: data race, race condition / TOCTOU, deadlock
defect_family_legend.logic: logic flaw, supply-chain injection, side-channel, crypto/protocol logic
defect_family_legend.ub: undefined behavior: null deref, integer overflow, type confusion, signed overflow

provenance_policy.fixing_commit.verified: true = short SHA taken from the official project advisory/commit page and confirmed to resolve on GitHub/GitLab; full 40-char SHA included only where the advisory page or widely-published record provides it.

false = fixing commit referenced only via the advisory URL (NVD / GitHub Advisory DB / project security advisory); full SHA must be resolved via the referenced URL or GitHub API in an environment with network egress.
provenance_policy.cvss.source: Most CVSS base scores are NVD-enriched values (see nvd.nist.gov). They are recorded with the label 'nvd-reported' and SHOULD be re-verified via NVD 2.0 API before publication; this batch could not reach NVD API reliably (TLS resets behind local proxy).
provenance_policy.build_status: No defect was actually compiled in this environment: WSL Ubuntu has no network egress (localhost proxy not mirrored to WSL). 'script-provided-not-executed' means a clone+checkout+build script is provided and the project ships a standard build system (autotools/cmake/meson); buildability is assessed from build-system presence, not measured.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/webmproject/libwebp && cd libwebp && git checkout v1.3.1 && ./autogen.sh && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: Decode a crafted lossless WebP image exercising BuildHuffmanTable with inconsistent Huffman code counts.
defects.notes: Real upstream defect; the widely-vendored copy inside Chrome/WebKit shares the same root cause. Fix lands in 1.3.2.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/curl/curl && cd curl && git checkout curl-8_3_0 && autoreconf -fi && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: Use a SOCKS5 proxy and a hostname longer than 255 bytes so curl falls back to local resolution and overflows a heap buffer.
defects.notes: Both fixing commit (fb4415d8aee6c1) and introducing commit (4a4b63daaa) cited by the official curl advisory.

fixing_commit.source: openssl/openssl commit page (full SHA from widely-published Heartbleed record)

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl && cd openssl && git checkout OpenSSL_1_0_1f && ./config && make
defects.trigger: Send a malformed TLS heartbeat request with a large payload length field to read up to 64 KB of process memory.
defects.notes: Heartbleed. Commit title 'Add heartbeat extension bounds check.' Full 40-char SHA confirmed against the canonical Heartbleed record.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl && cd openssl && git checkout openssl-3.0.6 && ./config && make
defects.trigger: Present an X.509 certificate with a malicious punycode-encoded email address during verification.
defects.notes: Punycode 4-byte stack overflow in ossl_punycode_decode. Fixed alongside CVE-2022-3786 in 3.0.7.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl && cd openssl && git checkout openssl-3.0.6 && ./config && make
defects.trigger: Present an X.509 certificate whose punycode email address lets attacker-controlled '.' bytes overflow the stack buffer.
defects.notes: Companion to CVE-2022-3602; both fixed in 3.0.7.

fixing_commit.source: GitHub commit (lede-project backport of upstream zlib 1.2.13 fix)

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/madler/zlib && cd zlib && git checkout v1.2.12 && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: Call inflateGetHeader then inflate() on a stream with an oversized gzip header 'extra' field.
defects.notes: Only affects callers of inflateGetHeader. Upstream fix ships in zlib 1.2.13.

defects.build_command: git clone https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/polkit/polkit && cd polkit && git checkout 0.119 && meson setup build && ninja -C build
defects.trigger: Invoke pkexec with a crafted argv/env such that argument count handling reads environment variables as commands.
defects.notes: PwnKit. LPE present in default config of all major distros since 2009.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl && cd openssl && git checkout openssl-3.0.7 && ./config && make
defects.trigger: Send a very large number of RSA decryption queries to recover plaintext across a network (timing oracle).
defects.notes: Side-channel, not memory corruption; demonstrates the 'logic' family in real code.

fixing_commit.source: GitLab libxml2 commit (v2.10.0; note: 5930fe... is the CVE-2022-2309 fix in the same release train)

defects.build_command: git clone https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2 && cd libxml2 && git checkout v2.9.14 && ./autogen.sh && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: Parse a crafted XML/HPE document that frees a node still referenced by an XPath expression.
defects.notes: UAF in libxml2 HPE handling. Fix shipped in 2.10.0.

defects.build_command: git clone https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2 && cd libxml2 && git checkout v2.10.3 && ./autogen.sh && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: Parse certain invalid XSD schemas leading to a NULL pointer dereference and segfault.
defects.notes: Classic UB family example in widely-embedded C library.

defects.build_command: git clone https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2 && cd libxml2 && git checkout v2.10.2 && ./autogen.sh && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: Parse a crafted multibyte content triggering an integer overflow in input handling.
defects.notes: Integer overflow addressed via improved input validation (Google Project Zero).

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz && cd xz && git checkout v5.6.1 && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: Indirect: sshd links liblzma; the backdoor hooks RSA key verification to grant unauthorized access.
defects.notes: Not an accidental bug but an intentional backdoor introduced by a maintainer over ~3 years; included as the strongest 'logic / supply-chain' real-world case.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl && cd openssl && git checkout openssl-3.0.8 && ./config && make
defects.trigger: Process a crafted X.400 address in a certificate leading to a NULL deref during policy checks.
defects.notes: UB family: NULL deref from unchecked X.400 address handling.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl && cd openssl && git checkout openssl-3.0.7 && ./config && make
defects.trigger: Crafted X.400 address misinterpreted as a different ASN.1 type during GENERAL_NAME comparison.
defects.notes: Type confusion (CWE-843) — a clean UB-family real case.

defects.build_command: git clone https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls && cd gnutls && git checkout 3.6.13 && ./bootstrap && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: TLS 1.3 session resumption uses a all-zero (instead of random) secret, weakening forward secrecy.
defects.notes: Logic/crypto-family: a correctness flaw, not memory corruption.

defects.build_command: git clone https://sourceware.org/git/glibc.git && cd glibc && git checkout glibc-2.34 && mkdir build && cd build && ../configure && make
defects.trigger: Crafted DNS response with excessive addresses overflows the getaddrinfo buffer.
defects.notes: glibc build is heavy; buildability assessed from glibc's standard configure/make.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/torvalds/linux && cd linux && git checkout v4.8.2 && make defconfig && make -j$(nproc)
defects.trigger: Race between a write and a page-fault copy-on-write on a read-only memory-mapped file to gain write to read-only pages.
defects.notes: Concurrency family representative (kernel race). Full kernel build is heavy; assessed only.

defects.build_command: git clone https://sourceware.org/git/glibc.git && cd glibc && git checkout glibc-2.17 && mkdir build && cd build && ../configure && make
defects.trigger: Pass an over-long hostname to gethostbyname triggering a buffer overflow.
defects.notes: GHOST. Memory-safety family; glibc build assessed, not executed.

defects.build_command: git clone https://sourceware.org/git/glibc.git && cd glibc && git checkout glibc-2.26 && mkdir build && cd build && ../configure && make
defects.trigger: Crafted realpath() input with an empty path component triggers an off-by-one/underflow.
defects.notes: Memory-safety family; build assessed, not executed.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg && cd FFmpeg && git checkout n3.2.1 && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: A malicious HTTP server sends a crafted chunked-encoded response overflowing a heap buffer in http.c.
defects.notes: Verified fix commit from Seebug/GitHub.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl && cd openssl && git checkout OpenSSL_1_1_1i && ./config && make
defects.trigger: Calls to EVP_CipherUpdate / EVP_EncryptUpdate / EVP_DecryptUpdate with a large output length overflow the length variable.
defects.notes: Integer overflow in cipher update path.

defects.build_command: git clone https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite && cd sqlite && git checkout version-3.27.2 && ./configure && make
defects.trigger: A crafted SQL query using FTS3/RTree auxiliary functions overflows a heap buffer.
defects.notes: Memory-safety family in a ubiquitous embedded DB engine.
